articles.title: 8th Pay Commission consultations gather pace: Tracking 8 key pensioner demands of RSCWS on pay, retirement security
articles.summary: 8th Pay Commission: The Commission is reviewing eight pensioner demands raised by RSCWS, including higher basic pay, revised HRA, transport allowance and stronger retirement benefits. The RSCWS proposals aim to improve pensions for Indian Railway employees.

articles.title: Finance Ministry moves to enable MDR on UPI — Here's what scrapping zero MDR provision means for UPI users

articles.title: REITs vs REIT mutual funds: Structure, taxation rules, returns and suitability for investors compared
articles.summary: REITs and REIT mutual funds offer investors exposure to the real estate sector but differ in structure, taxation, and returns. While REITs focus on rental income from properties, REIT funds combine REIT exposure with real estate equities.

articles.title: New Fund Offer: Should you invest in an NFO when a similar mutual fund with a proven track record exists?
articles.summary: If a similar mutual fund with a proven track record already exists in the market, experts say investors should prefer an established scheme unless the NFO offers a genuinely differentiated strategy that complements their portfolio and investment goals.

articles.title: Value funds: Only two schemes have negative alpha; Quant and DSP lead category in benchmark outperformance
articles.summary: Only two value funds have negative alpha, indicating they lag their benchmark indices, while Quant Value Fund and DSP Value Fund record the highest positive alpha. The contrast in alpha was also reflected in return performance, with the positive-alpha funds delivering better returns.

articles.title: Has EPFO wage ceiling been raised to ₹25,000? Here's what report says about the monthly contribution limit
articles.summary: Finance Ministry has approved an increase in EPF wage ceiling to ₹25,000 monthly from current ₹15,000, as per a Moneycontrol report. If approved this would expand coverage to more salaried workers.

articles.title: How to report F&O income in ITR for AY 2026-27: Deadline, turnover, audit rules and key changes in tax forms
articles.summary: F&O trading is treated as non-speculative business income and must be reported under business income in ITR. For AY 2026-27, taxpayers need to disclose F&O turnover and income in dedicated fields in ITR forms. They also need to comply with tax audit and carry-forward rules.

articles.title: How capital gains on foreign shares are computed and taxed in India
articles.summary: Upon returning to India, the person must compute capital gains from US shares in INR, using the exchange rate from the sale date. No concessions for rupee depreciation apply. Long-term gains are taxed at 12.5%, and disclosure of foreign assets is required for tax purposes.
